registry.parseSkillsShRetiredRegistry(raw: unknow: null for anything not a well-formed v1 registry; reader decides (absent file = nothing retired)
registry.isRetiredSkillsShRoot(rootId: string, re: own-property lookup; for the loader (discoverSkillsShPluginPaths) which has dir names
registry.isRetiredSourceRef(sourceRef: string | n: true only for 'skills-sh:<rootId>' with rootId listed; for buildSkills pass 1 sidecar filter

itemIdentity.HarnessRetiredItemId: `skills-sh:${string}` | `mcp:${string}` — equals the ledger itemId; skills-sh form equals the clone sidecar sourceRef

pathIdentity.HarnessRetiredPath: { relPath: string /* target path exactly as HarnessPlanRemove.relPath: workspace-relative POSIX, '<config>#<serverKey>' fragment, or '~/'-prefixed home fragment */; itemId: HarnessRetiredItemId }
pathIdentity.harnessPathIdentity(workspaceRoot: strin: the ledger key (removedPaths/keptPaths/failedPaths) and notice path: '~/' relPath returned unchanged (counts once across workspaces); otherwise `${root}/${rel}` with backslashes -> '/', trailing root separators and leading rel separators dropped. Pass the resolveHarnessWorkspaceRoot value.

results.HarnessApplyResult.removedRetired?: Harn: deleted on proof; every relPath ALSO in `removed` (manifest pruning unchanged)
results.HarnessApplyResult.keptRetired?: Harness: kept on disk and disowned; NOT in `removed`; reconciler must drop their manifest entries; never snapshot-removed
results.HarnessWriteFailure.itemId?: HarnessReti: set only for a failed retired removal; entry stays owned, next pass retries; ledger files it under failedPaths
results.HarnessTargetHealth.removedRetired? / ke: same element types, merged per target by the reconciler; HarnessHealth carries them via targets[]

portInputs.HarnessPlanRemove.retiredItemId?: Harnes: set by the planner when the manifest source lies under a retired skill root or the MCP key is retired; marks the removal for the D-2 proof policy
portInputs.HarnessRetiredSources: { skillSourceRoots: readonly string[] /* absolute dirs; itemId = skillsShRetiredItemId(basename(root)) */; mcpServerKeys: readonly string[] } — the reconciler option `retired`, rebuilt from both registries every pass (threading into reconcile options/plan is Batch 22+ work)

decisions.decision: removedRetired/keptRetired live on HarnessTargetHealth (per target), not as new top-level HarnessHealth fields.
decisions.evidence: Every existing path list (removed, removedLocalEdit, writeFailed, keptLocalEdit) is per target in HarnessTargetHealth; HarnessHealth reaches them through targets[]. A second top-level copy would be a duplicate the reducers must keep in step.

decisions.decision: Result entries carry itemId, and HarnessWriteFailure gains optional itemId.
decisions.evidence: The D-D10 ledger groups removedPaths/keptPaths/failedPaths per itemId (implementation-plan.md:836-850); a bare relPath cannot be attributed to an item after the reconciler prunes its manifest entry.
Neighbour stores use ISO strings: mcp-intent-store.ts installedAt z.string() (:51,:129), skills-sh-source-root.ts installedAt z.string() (:100).
